message: Use the latest ARM common-types version 'v6' instead of 'v5'.
Properties with type:object must have definition of a reference model.

The RP-specific property model in the 'properties' property of this resource must contain a 'provisioningState property.  The property type should be an enum or a union of string values, and it must specify known state values 'Succeeded', 'Failed', and 'Canceled'.
Query parameter 'top' should be removed. Collection GET/list operations must not have query parameters other than api-version and $filter.
Query parameter 'skip' should be removed. Collection GET/list operations must not have query parameters other than api-version and $filter.
Query parameter 'maxpagesize' should be removed. Collection GET/list operations must not have query parameters other than api-version and $filter.
Please provide x-ms-examples describing minimum/maximum property set for response/request payloads for operations.
